nora: Sprinter reached out: want a short joint perf/W bench and a tiny kernel instrumentation pass next week. Can we scope owners? cc @evan @rachel
evan: I'll take marketing + partner comms. rachel: test harness + workloads for me. propose batches [1,4], seq [64,256], models [gpt-small-open]. single-replica for clarity.
tom: I'll own kernel probes. target hotspots: matmul, attention, memcpy. will collect PMU: cycles, LLC-load-misses. recommend FP16 smoke first; INT8 follow-up.
nora: timeline: Sprinter needs preliminary numbers in 6 days. feasible?
rachel: feasible for smoke + one trace if we get access by Tue. reserving 1x80GB GPU and VLAN.
evan: I'll get VPN creds and coordinate embargo/sign-off. drafting a one-pager for partner now.
